scope: Publish exact source/results bytes with bounded, reconstructible byte chunks.

summary.scope: Archive closed physical-reference fields, qualifications and diagnostics without accepting physical convergence.

fixed-polyhedron-raw-peak-cell-diagnosis.scope: Locate audited raw peaks and inspect boundary compatibility and unsmoothed incident-cell stress jumps.
fixed-polyhedron-raw-peak-cell-diagnosis.limitations: Diagnoses the exact separately audited raw peaks and original boundary law on three meshes. The fixed-polyhedron family freezes CAD geometry, while volume/surface basis and boundary quadrature still refine together. A single symmetric stress tensor requires n_i dot t_j = n_j dot t_i. Measured incompatibility concerns continuity of one stress tensor at that boundary vertex. It does not prove a stress singularity or continuum peak growth, and zero local defect does not exclude other singularities. Same-vertex unsmoothed cell jumps and mean-ratio quality are diagnostics, not continuum errors or a causal explanation. Normal-only traces are algebraic controls only, not replacement physical loads. Original full fields, raw maxima, radii, loads and numerical budgets remain unchanged.

limitations: All30 original raw maxima/positions and all original full fields remain. Exact auditor/field peak checks precede boundary-depth, incident-traction compatibility, every-cell mean-ratio quality and unsmoothed same-vertex tensor diagnostics. Tensor jumps and local traction residuals are diagnostics, not error budgets, singularity proofs or causal explanations. Pending local mesh generation solves zero new equilibria and is excluded from accepted physical results. Files of at least50MB are preserved as exact ordered32MiB byte ranges, individually gzip-compressed, with original/part/stored SHA256 and offsets. Join decompressed ranges in index order to restore the original file exactly; no records are reduced or excluded. Runtime staging uses hard links for unchanged small originals.
